name: disk-artifact-bloat
question: Is the dev drive running low on free space (regenerable build-artifact bloat risk)?
cost_provenance: Get-PSDrive / df is effectively instant; 800ms is a pessimistic PowerShell cold-start allowance measured 2026-06-30 on win32 (slowest supported environment).

schema.tripped: boolean (true iff a free-space threshold or drift trip fired; equals briefing != '')
schema.drive: string|null (the drive checked, e.g. 'S:' on Windows or the mount path on POSIX; null when undeterminable)
schema.free_gb: number|null (free space in GiB; null when undeterminable -> graceful empty)
schema.total_gb: number|null (total capacity in GiB; null when undeterminable)
schema.drift_gb: number|null (free-space DROP since the last sweep baseline; null when no baseline)
schema.baseline_age_days: number|null (age of the baseline used for drift; null when no baseline)
schema.briefing: string (empty when level==ok and no drift trip -> session-start suppresses the line)

_briefingForms.warn: "<drive> <free> GB free (warn < <warn> GB)<drift clause> -- run ~/.claude/scripts/disk-artifact-sweep.ps1 (dry-run) to inspect"
_briefingForms.alert: "ALERT <drive> <free> GB free (alert < <alert> GB)<drift clause> -- run ~/.claude/scripts/disk-artifact-sweep.ps1 to reclaim regenerable artifacts"
_briefingForms.drift_only: "<drive> free dropped <N> GB since last sweep (<D>d ago) -- run ~/.claude/scripts/disk-artifact-sweep.ps1 -Scan"

defaults.root: (unset) -> check the drive of the current working directory; set to force a specific drive/path

config.baseline_path: ~/.claude/session-state/disk-artifact-baseline.json (written by disk-artifact-sweep; read here for the drift clause; gracefully absent)

fallback: Run `Get-PSDrive <letter>` (Windows) or `df -kP <path>` (POSIX) for the dev drive's free space. Compare against the warn/alert thresholds. For drift, read ~/.claude/session-state/disk-artifact-baseline.json and subtract current free_bytes from baseline free_bytes.
graceful_absence: When the drive's free space cannot be read (path absent on this machine, df/Get-PSDrive failure), the oracle emits free_gb=null with an empty briefing. It therefore ships in the starter set on every machine but only ever speaks where a real dev drive crosses a threshold.

design_lineage: stranded-dirty-files (CSI-15) -- same starter-set hygiene-oracle shape, frozen JSON schema, empty-briefing-suppresses-line discipline
provenance.note: Cheap every-session tripwire only. The heavy artifact enumeration + cleanup lives in scripts/disk-artifact-sweep.{ps1,sh}, which also writes the baseline this oracle reads. Trigger: 2026-06-30 SourceControlled HDD->SSD migration (447 GB usable; full artifact footprint exceeds the disk).
